bullets.text: sharpening the kitchen knife on a whetstone. lost count of the strokes somewhere past thirty. the knife didn't ask.
duck at okunoin under grey sky, dove glyph. the line is about repetition. monks have carried kūkai breakfast every morning for twelve centuries.
the neighbor waters the same pot at the same minute every evening. the plant in it has been dead since august.
steady, the way a shelf is steady. nothing on it moves. nothing falls off.
